required_outcomes: Recognises that the provider's call, the job record, the confirmation emails, the reminder text and the tenant all give Monday 8 September 2025, 10 to 12, so there is no conflict to resolve.
Replies to the tenant confirming the visit is Monday 8 September, 10am to 12pm, with Keystone Compliance (not Monday 1 September), and how to rearrange if needed.
Returns the job to auto mode (or leaves it on hold for the provider with the visit date as the review point) without rebooking, re-assigning or escalating.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending the provider a one-line note that the tenant has re-confirmed 8 September, provided the tenant is answered.
Offering in the reply to ask the provider for an earlier slot if she would prefer one, without changing the booking.
positive_behaviours: Explains that the text's date in brackets (08/09/2025) means 8 September, to clear up the confusion.
red_flags: Escalating to a human, or asking the provider to re-confirm a date it has already set and confirmed, before answering the tenant.
Treating the call as a date dispute and telling the tenant the date is unconfirmed.
prohibited_actions: Creating a new ticket, assigning another contractor or moving the visit.
critical_failures: Leaving the tenant without an answer, or giving her a date other than Monday 8 September.
